description: Libas Consumer Products Limited engages in the fabrication of fabric into garments and other products through customization in India. The company also engages in the trade of rock salt and other related material. It markets its products under the Riyaz Gangji Libas and the Reshma Riyaz Gangji Libas brands. The company was formerly known as Libas Designs Limited and changed its name to Libas Consumer Products Limited in November 2020. Libas Consumer Products Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Mumbai, India.
